zh-CN.title: 妖怪夜市开张
zh-CN.short: 招来妖怪帮工，备餐、挂灯、摆好摊位。用手里的牌化解闹场、抢先完成开张清单，与隔壁摊主比一比谁先开市。
zh-CN.about:
[h2]今晚，和隔壁比谁先开张[/h2]
夜市开张前，锅要热，货要齐，灯也得挂好。你和隔壁摊主各有一份清单：安排手里的妖怪帮工，完成备货、备餐、挂灯、招客和布符。谁先做完，谁先开市。

[h2]安排帮工，也要留意隔壁[/h2]
快工两轮做完一项工作，慢工要四轮。人手和位置有限，先把谁派上去、下一轮留什么牌，都得算一算。

[h2]麻烦来了，手里留一招[/h2]
漏雨、灯线故障、小鬼闹场，都可能打断安排。修补能让帮工继续干活，搭把手能赶一赶进度；碰上巡街，还得在时机内拿出调停牌。

[h2]一张牌，听一句夜市闲话[/h2]
当前内容有95张卡牌、28份开张委托和两页教学。单人对战电脑摊主，中文与英文界面可切换。纸面卡框、暖灯和木桌围出这一晚的小摊。
zh-CN.featureNotes: 无在线多人、关卡解锁或局内保存承诺；95/28 是牌/委托数量，不是95张独立插画或95个独立角色。

en.title: Yokai Night Market
en.short: Put your yokai helpers to work, keep the lanterns lit, and finish your stall's opening checklist before your rival. Play cards to lend a hand, mend a mishap, or stir up trouble next door.
en.about:
[h2]Open your stall before the neighbours[/h2]
The pot needs heating, the shelves need filling, and the lanterns are still waiting. You and a computer-controlled rival each have an opening checklist. Assign your yokai helpers to supplies, food, lanterns, guests, and wards. Finish all five jobs first to open the market.

[h2]Choose who works next[/h2]
Fast helpers finish a task in two turns; slower helpers take four. Your work slots are limited, so make room for the right helper and keep an eye on the next turn.

[h2]Keep a card for trouble[/h2]
Leaks, broken lantern wires, and rowdy spirits can interrupt the work. Repair mishaps, lend a hand to speed things up, or find the right moment to mediate a patrol.

[h2]A little talk around the night market[/h2]
The current game contains 95 cards, 28 opening commissions, and a two-page tutorial. Play solo against a computer rival with Chinese and English interface options, on painted paper cards around a lantern-lit wooden counter.
